title: Perps deposit tap is responsive and Pay With tokens load
description: Unlocks the Trading fixture account, opens Perps home, taps Add funds, and proves confirmation plus the Pay With token sheet appear without the pre-fix multi-second stall. Setup follows the perps.smoke unlock and Perps navigation pattern.

setup-unlock.intent: Unlock the fixture wallet before opening Perps

setup-account.intent: Select the funded Trading account for the deposit flow
setup-account.name: Trading

setup-open-perps.intent: Open the Perps home screen where deposit is triggered

gate-wait-heading.intent: Confirm Perps home has finished rendering its title

gate-wait-deposit.intent: Confirm the deposit CTA is on screen before using it

ac1-press-deposit.intent: Begin the Perps deposit confirmation from home

ac1-wait-confirmation.intent: Confirm the deposit amount screen appeared without a multi-second stall

ac1-wait-pay-with.intent: Confirm Pay With is mounted on the deposit confirmation

ac1-screenshot-confirmation.intent: Record the deposit confirmation after a responsive Add funds tap
ac1-screenshot-confirmation.label: AC1: deposit confirmation after Add funds

ac2-press-pay-with.intent: Show every token that can fund this Perps deposit

ac2-wait-token-sheet.intent: Confirm the Pay With token sheet listed a crypto asset

ac2-screenshot-token-list.intent: Record the Pay With token sheet after first open
ac2-screenshot-token-list.label: AC2: Pay With token sheet
